title: The data catalog vocabulary
description: DCAT is an RDF vocabulary designed to facilitate interoperability between data catalogs published on the Web. By using DCAT to describe datasets in data catalogs, publishers increase discoverability and enable applications easily to consume metadata from multiple catalogs. It further enables decentralized publishing of catalogs and facilitates federated dataset search across sites. Aggregated DCAT metadata can serve as a manifest file to facilitate digital preservation. DCAT is defined at http://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat/. Any variance between that normative document and this schema is an error in this schema.

terms.label: Catalog
terms.definition: A curated collection of metadata about resources.
comments: A curated collection of metadata about resources (e.g., datasets and data services in the context of a data catalog).

terms.label: Catalog Record
terms.definition: A record in a data catalog, describing the registration of a single dataset or data service.
comments: A record in a data catalog, describing the registration of a single dataset or data service.

terms.label: Catalogued resource
terms.definition: Resource published or curated by a single agent.
comments: Resource published or curated by a single agent.

terms.label: Data service
terms.definition: A site or end-point providing operations related to the discovery of, access to, or processing functions on, data or related resources.
comments: A site or end-point providing operations related to the discovery of, access to, or processing functions on, data or related resources.

terms.label: Dataset
terms.definition: A collection of data, published or curated by a single source, and available for access or download in one or more representations.
comments: A collection of data, published or curated by a single source, and available for access or download in one or more representations.

terms.label: Dataset series
terms.definition: A collection of datasets that are published separately, but share some common characteristics that groups them.
comments: A collection of datasets that are published separately, but share some characteristics that group them.

terms.label: Distribution
terms.definition: A specific representation of a dataset. A dataset might be available in multiple serializations that may differ in various ways, including natural language, media-type or format, schematic organization, temporal and spatial resolution, level of detail or profiles (which might specify any or all of the above).
comments: A specific representation of a dataset. A dataset might be available in multiple serializations that may differ in various ways, including natural language, media-type or format, schematic organization, temporal and spatial resolution, level of detail or profiles (which might specify any or all of the above).

terms.label: Relationship
terms.definition: An association class for attaching additional information to a relationship between DCAT Resources.
comments: An association class for attaching additional information to a relationship between DCAT Resources.

terms.label: Role
terms.definition: A role is the function of a resource or agent with respect to another resource, in the context of resource attribution or resource relationships.
comments: A role is the function of a resource or agent with respect to another resource, in the context of resource attribution or resource relationships.

terms.label: access address
terms.definition: A URL of a resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset. E.g. landing page, feed, SPARQL endpoint. Use for all cases except a simple download link, in which case downloadURL is preferred.
comments: A URL of a resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset. E.g. landing page, feed, SPARQL endpoint. Use for all cases except a simple download link, in which case downloadURL is preferred.

terms.label: catalog
terms.definition: A catalog that is listed in the catalog.
comments: A catalog that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: compression format
terms.definition: The compression format of the distribution in which the data is contained in a compressed form, e.g. to reduce the size of the downloadable file.
comments: The compression format of the distribution in which the data is contained in a compressed form, e.g. to reduce the size of the downloadable file.

terms.label: contact point
terms.definition: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource. Use of vCard is recommended.
comments: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource. Use of vCard is recommended.

terms.label: data access service
terms.definition: A site or end-point that gives access to the distribution of the dataset.
comments: A site or end-point that gives access to the distribution of the dataset.

terms.label: dataset
terms.definition: A dataset that is listed in the catalog.
comments: A dataset that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: description of service end-point
terms.definition: A description of the service end-point, including its operations, parameters etc.
comments: A description of the service end-point, including its operations, parameters etc.

terms.label: distribution
terms.definition: An available distribution of the dataset.
comments: An available distribution of the dataset.

terms.label: download URL
terms.definition: The URL of the downloadable file in a given format. E.g. CSV file or RDF file. The format is indicated by the distribution's dcterms:format and/or dcat:mediaType.
comments: The URL of the downloadable file in a given format. E.g. CSV file or RDF file. The format is indicated by the distribution's dcterms:format and/or dcat:mediaType.

terms.label: first
terms.definition: The first resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.
comments: The first resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

terms.label: hadRole
terms.definition: The function of an entity or agent with respect to another entity or resource.
comments: The function of an entity or agent with respect to another entity or resource.

terms.label: has current version
terms.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource with equivalent content [PAV].
comments: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource with equivalent content [PAV].

terms.label: has version
terms.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource [PAV].
comments: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource [PAV].

terms.label: homepage
terms.definition: This axiom needed so that Protege loads DCAT 3 without errors.

terms.label: in series
terms.definition: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.
comments: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.

terms.label: landing page
terms.definition: A Web page that can be navigated to in a Web browser to gain access to the catalog, a dataset, its distributions and/or additional information.
comments: A Web page that can be navigated to in a Web browser to gain access to the catalog, a dataset, its distributions and/or additional information.

terms.label: last
terms.definition: The last resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.
comments: The last resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

terms.label: media type
terms.definition: The media type of the distribution as defined by IANA.
comments: The media type of the distribution as defined by IANA

terms.label: packaging format
terms.definition: The package format of the distribution in which one or more data files are grouped together, e.g. to enable a set of related files to be downloaded together.
comments: The package format of the distribution in which one or more data files are grouped together, e.g. to enable a set of related files to be downloaded together.

terms.label: previous
terms.definition: The previous resource (before the current one) in an ordered collection or series of resources.
comments: The previous resource (before the current one) in an ordered collection or series of resources.

terms.label: previous version
terms.definition: The previous version of a resource in a lineage [PAV].
comments: The previous version of a resource in a lineage [PAV].

terms.label: primaryTopic
terms.definition: This axiom needed so that Protege loads DCAT 3 without errors.

terms.label: qualified relation
terms.definition: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource.
comments: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource.

terms.label: record
terms.definition: A record describing the registration of a single dataset or data service that is part of the catalog.
comments: A record describing the registration of a single dataset or data service that is part of the catalog.

terms.label: resource
terms.definition: A resource that is listed in the catalog.
comments: A resource that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: serves dataset
terms.definition: A collection of data that this DataService can distribute.
comments: A collection of data that this DataService can distribute.

terms.label: service
terms.definition: A service that is listed in the catalog.
comments: A service that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: service end-point
terms.definition: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (a web-resolvable IRI).
comments: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (a web-resolvable IRI).

terms.label: theme
terms.definition: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.
comments: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.

terms.label: theme taxonomy
terms.definition: The knowledge organization system (KOS) used to classify catalog's datasets.
comments: The knowledge organization system (KOS) used to classify catalog's datasets.

terms.label: bounding box
terms.definition: The geographic bounding box of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].
comments: The geographic bounding box of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].

terms.label: byte size
terms.definition: The size of a distribution in bytes.
comments: The size of a distribution in bytes.

terms.label: centroid
terms.definition: The geographic center (centroid) of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].
comments: The geographic center (centroid) of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].

terms.label: end date
terms.definition: The end of the period.
comments: The end of the period.

terms.label: geografisk opløsning (meter)
terms.definition: mindste geografiske afstand som kan resolveres i et datasæt, målt i meter.

terms.label: keyword
terms.definition: A keyword or tag describing a resource.
comments: A keyword or tag describing a resource.

terms.label: start date
terms.definition: The start of the period

terms.label: temporal resolution
terms.definition: minimum time period resolvable in a dataset.
comments: minimum time period resolvable in a dataset.

terms.label: version
terms.definition: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
comments: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
